scope: Design-only simulation. No runtime import, medical gold label, clinical accuracy, or score change.
policy: C: strongest trusted grade per anatomical axis; Pareto non-dominance, no numeric sum

locationPolicies.L0: P or S at any confidence qualifies for Main
locationPolicies.L1: P/MEDIUM or S/MEDIUM qualifies; S/REVIEW stays Additional/reference
locationPolicies.L2: P only qualifies; prior sensitivity reproduced

guard: Classify once from the union Pareto frontier of trusted Main and trusted Additional; do not promote Additional to Main
reasonPrecedence: movement_unclear > location_unclear > no Main/stretch-only > additional-only frontier > mixed frontier (incomparable over equal) > main-only frontier
crossGroupCategory: Disjoint: Main0 first; remaining cases are Main-only, mixed, or Additional-only frontier

displayPolicies.D0: All Main, trusted Additional, S/REVIEW and T/REVIEW references
displayPolicies.D1: Main and all trusted Additional; T/REVIEW only when stretch-only; S/REVIEW hidden in normal result
displayPolicies.D2: Main and union-frontier trusted Additional; T/REVIEW only when stretch-only
